explicitApproximations.outer_plan: Strictly convex support-function rounded triangle h(theta)=r0[1+0.10 cos(3theta)] with 120 degree twist. This removes the old locally concave harmonic profile, while remaining a reconstruction rather than architect fabrication coordinates.
explicitApproximations.occupied_cylinder_radii_m: Verified lower circular plan41.8m radius, zone8 upper21m; linear taper between those anchors assumed.
explicitApproximations.core_widths_m: Constant 30 m overall grid in the lower9-cell / chamfer / five-cell cross; upper three-cell rectangle30x10 m. Exact clipping dimensions inferred from Fig3; no continuously shrinking empty square.
explicitApproximations.floor_levels: 124 numbered floors reconstructed piecewise between Fig6 surveyed-design anchors. Intermediate unlabelled elevations and F1=0 datum are assumed; final-built counted storeys may differ from this design-stage source.
explicitApproximations.mega_columns: Verified8 paired onorthogonal sides tozone8, visibleaxes rebuilt fromFig5 proportions: majorcoordinate=.91*inner_radius, minoroffset5m. Zone1section5.1x3.7, underground5.3x4.3, top2.4x1.9 sourceverified; linearinterpolation inbetween assumed.
explicitApproximations.pile_group: 947 representative 1 m diameter cylinders, 52 m below raft: retained as illustrative dense geometry, not a verified pile layout, quantity survey or design length.
explicitApproximations.tmd: 1000tonne rectangular mass-box with circular top platform, four anchor plate assemblies and12cables25m long; floor125/source-verified mechanism. Centre583.5m, dimensions, magnetic poles, frame members and fasteners are explicit geometric reconstruction assumptions; artwork excluded.
explicitApproximations.six_skin_sectors: Animation decomposition groups only, not six real fabrication seams.
explicitApproximations.crown: Nonlevel open rim visually reconstructed from public section; only the 632 m maximum is source verified.
explicitApproximations.corner_columns: Verified4 tozone5; radialaxis=.95*inner radius, square2.0to1.3m sections assumed.
explicitApproximations.outriggers: Six verified zones 2,4,5,6,7,8. Exact upper/lower chord levels and member sections are unverified; initially placed in the8.6 m below selected zone boundary as an explicit analytical assumption.
explicitApproximations.belt_trusses: Eight verified two-storey box belts; secondary posts/gussets/flange thicknesses and exact fabricated member sizes illustrative.
